zh-CN.title: 聊天输入与导航更顺手
items: 修复深色会话标题与平板返回，群聊人数不再重复显示
桌面加号改为浮动菜单，支持切换紧凑输入，短横屏默认折叠，并新增换行按钮

en.title: Smoother chat navigation and composing
items: Improve dark chat headers and tablet back navigation; show group counts only once
Desktop More opens a popover with compact mode, automatic short-screen folding and a newline button
